note: Crawford County (IA) zones unincorporated land through its Zoning office (Engineer's Office, Denison), but no digital zoning district layer is published. The county zoning page links no GIS or REST service. Denison, the county seat and largest city, publishes its zoning only as a poster-size PDF map. Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub and the Iowa state map servers found no Crawford County or Denison zoning polygon layer. The only Iowa zoning service hit was Council Bluffs, which is outside this county.
